user.title: Delta Chat relay
user.description: Create a Delta Chat bot account on a chatmail relay. This can take a minute.

invite.title: Invite people
invite.description:
Scan this QR code in Delta Chat on each phone that should get notifications, or open {invite}

Once someone has joined, add them on the integration page with **Add recipient**.

error.cannot_connect: Could not create an account on the relay

user.title: Add recipient
user.description:
Scan this QR code in Delta Chat on the recipient's phone, or open {invite}

Then pick them below. If they're not listed yet, wait a few seconds and submit again.

error.no_contacts: Nobody new has joined yet. Scan the QR code first.
